subject: Evaluation follow-up: API compatibility, cloud comparisons, next tests
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Aliya Hassan <aliya@pioneerretail.com>, Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@pioneerretail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation follow-up: API compatibility, cloud comparisons, next tests

Hi Aliya / Ravi —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a concrete set of low-effort next steps so your engineering team can validate whether Redwood fits the migration path:

Call recap (2-min):
- Primary goal: migrate inference for product search ranking from Vertex/Bedrock evaluations to a controllable production runtime.
- Key constraints: OpenAI-compatible API surface, minimal prompt deltas, predictable tail latency, and data residency for PII-sensitive logs.

Suggested next tests (we can supply test keys & a mini-script):
1) API/SDK swap: run your existing OpenAI request flow against Redwood’s OpenAI-compatible endpoint (no code changes beyond swapping host + key). Measure token throughput, 95th/99th p99 latency, and output parity.
2) Prompt-diff: run 50 representative prompts (search+re-rank templates) and compare top-5 outputs and log-likelihood deltas to flag regressions.
3) Batching & cache baseline: run with your typical burst pattern to observe batching benefits and KV cache hit rates.
4) Hyperscaler A/B: head-to-head with Bedrock/Vertex using identical prompts, track cost-per-1000-tokens and tail-latency.

I attached a short compatibility checklist to make the tests repeatable: compat-checklist.xlsx (staged test keys, sample curl/python snippets, metric collection fields).

Who should we provision a short-lived staging key for? If you can point me to a single engineer (or we can create a scoped key for the team), we’ll also provide a short script that collects the exact metrics you requested.

Possible timeline: if you sign off by EOD Tue, we can have a first pass within 48 business hours.

Thanks —
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: compat-checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)]
From: Aliya Hassan <aliya@pioneerretail.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation follow-up: API compatibility, cloud comparisons, next tests

Thanks, Aditya —

This is exactly the kind of checklist we wanted. Quick answers:
- Please provision a staging key that is rate-limited to our test env (we'll give you a single engineer to use it).
- Yes, we'll run the 50-prompt prompt-diff and share results.
- One ask: Pioneer is already running PoCs with AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex; can you provide a short summary of where Redwood materially differs vs those options (not a full deck — a 1-pager with operational diffs would help our GTM/infra folks).

Looping in Ravi (engineering) — Ravi, can you be our contact for the staging tests?

Thanks,
Aliya Hassan
CTO, Pioneer Retail
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Aliya Hassan <aliya@pioneerretail.com>, Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@pioneerretail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation follow-up: API compatibility, cloud comparisons, next tests

Aliya / Ravi —

Appreciate the quick reply. We’ll create a scoped staging key for Ravi and share instructions tomorrow. Attached is a concise one-pager that highlights where Redwood’s inference offering differs vs hyperscaler managed endpoints — operational and cost levers only (redwood-vs-cloud-onepager.pdf). High level:

Differentiators vs Bedrock / Vertex (short):
- Predictable tail latency: deterministic kernels + continuous batching tuned for your sequence-length distribution; measured p99 improvements in real customer workloads.
- Cost controls: configurable batching + automatic prefix KV caching reduces token counts on repeat prompt patterns (search/rerank use case).
- Unified surface for hosted/dedicated/private: if you need a private VPC or on-prem later, same API and rollback controls.
- Rollouts & fallbacks: built-in canary/auto-fallback to smaller model variants to keep SLOs during congestion.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdowns, per-model latency heatmaps, and automatic prompt-diff alerts.

Proposed quick A/B test (30–90m):
1) Baseline: run 1000 prompts against your Bedrock/Vertex setup and capture median/p95/p99 latency and token spend.
2) Redwood: run the same 1000 prompts against Redwood (OpenAI-compatible endpoint) with identical model & params.
3) Prompt-diff: create a simple script that compares top-5 outputs and token counts.

We’ll provide:
- Staging key (scoped, revocable).
- A small python script (requests + pandas) to run the A/B and emit a CSV of metrics.
- A minimal checklist for reproducibility (the attached one-pager + the spreadsheet you already have).

Next actions:
- Aditya: provision key for Ravi by EOD Wed (I’ll follow up when it’s ready).
- Ravi: confirm which environment (staging vs integration) you want the key scoped for.
- Aliya: if possible, share the 50 example prompts by Wed so we can pre-flight the prompt-diff script.

Thanks —
Aditya
[Attachment: redwood-vs-cloud-onepager.pdf (pdf, 95KB)]
From: Aliya Hassan <aliya@pioneerretail.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@pioneerretail.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation follow-up: API compatibility, cloud comparisons, next tests

Thanks — that works for us.

Ravi: please confirm you want the key scoped to staging (preferred) or to our test-integration cluster. We should be able to run the 1k prompt A/B on Thurs/Friday if Ravi confirms.

Aditya — can you copy in your security contact (SOC/infosec) as well? Our security team will want a quick checklist (SOC2 scope, data retention, key rotation).

Lauren: thanks for helping coordinate — quick note: if Redwood can demonstrate parity on the 50 prompts + better 95/99 latency on the A/B, we can fast-track a procurement conversation.
